reasons: Datadog docker.cpu.user is a percent of one core (100 = one full core), while container.cpu.usage.usermode is a monotonic sum in ns, so the units differ and a scale is needed.
The candidate applies the scale inside promql with the constants 100 and 1e7, which the hard rules forbid; the scale must be proposed in notes only.
The applied scale is also wrong: percent of one core is rate_ns/1e7, so the extra factor of 100 makes the result 100x too large.
Quantity (CPU usage per container), rate on the monotonic sum, avg by container_name, and dropped $scope are otherwise consistent with the request and the observed labels.
